[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Thomas's birth date is not established. An inherited family-tree account places him in 1781, with an uncertain March date at Eccles. That estimate is retained for comparison; the possible memorial entry below does not establish his birth or death.

== Research Notes ==
=== Earlier date and family account ===

The earlier biography stated: Thomas was born in 1781.

Those inherited claims remain in the research account, but have not been established by the record comparison made here.

=== Eccles memorial comparison ===
The Eccles and Birgham churchyard memorial transcript names [[Glasgow-3706|Robert Glasgow]], joiner and feuar at Leitholm, his wife [[Whitehead-9630|Agnes Whitehead]], daughter Euphans and two sons named Thomas. It gives one Thomas's death as April 1790, aged 8, and the other's as 27 April 1791, aged 3. Euphans died on 7 April 1791, aged 5. Robert's death is transcribed as 8 October 1800 or 1809, aged 55; Agnes's as 21 May 1840, aged 84. The two Thomas entries and Euphans's companion entry repeat one monument and are not independent witnesses.<ref name="EcclesMemorialTranscripts">Findmypast, ''Scotland Monumental Inscriptions'', Eccles and Birgham Churchyards, Berwickshire; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=PRS%2FSCOTLAND%2FMI%2FADD%2F5%2F00542644 Thomas Glasgow, April 1790, aged 8, PRS/SCOTLAND/MI/ADD/5/00542644] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=PRS%2FSCOTLAND%2FMI%2FADD%2F5%2F00542645 Thomas Glasgow, 27 April 1791, aged 3, PRS/SCOTLAND/MI/ADD/5/00542645], derivative transcripts inspected 30 October 2026; [https://findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=PRS%2FSCOTLAND%2FMI%2FADD%2F5%2F00352695 Euphans Glasgow, 7 April 1791, aged 5, PRS/SCOTLAND/MI/ADD/5/00352695], derivative transcript inspected 23 October 2026. These are companion entries from one inscription; the original monument or photograph has not been inspected.</ref>

Thomas is a candidate for the elder son in this memorial. His unverified March 1781 Eccles birth would imply about 9 years of age in April 1790, compared with the reported age of 8. This weak, unverified birth estimate does not exclude him, but the discrepancy prevents an established identification. His FamilySearch tree citation does not by itself establish the underlying birth entry. The younger son has not been assigned to an existing profile.

The ages imply that the two same-named sons' lifetimes overlapped. That unusual feature, the elder son's age discrepancy and Robert's ambiguous death year require checking against the original inscription or a photograph and the Eccles parish entries. The indexed birth years 1782 and 1788 are derived from ages at death, not recorded birth dates. The churchyard locality does not establish either son's birthplace or exact burial date. Neither Thomas's death nor his parents are established by this comparison.
